buy_target.enter_channel_link: 📢 Add Channel Please enter your channel @username or ID: Examples: • @mychannel • https://t.me/mychannel • -1001234567890 (for private channels) 💡 To get channel ID, forward any message from your channel to @userinfobot
buy_target.enter_group_link: 👥 Add Group Please enter your group @username or ID: Examples: • @mygroup • https://t.me/mygroup • -1001234567890 (for private groups) 💡 To get group ID, add @userinfobot to your group

buy_target.target_created: ✅ Target Added! Name: {name} Type: {type} Now you can create orders to receive subscribers!
buy_target.no_orders_for_target: No orders yet for this target. Create your first order!
buy_target.remove_target_confirm: ⚠️ Remove Target Are you sure you want to remove this target? Note: Active orders will be paused. This action cannot be undone!
buy_target.target_removed_success: ✅ Target Removed Target "{name}" has been successfully removed.
buy_target.invalid_link: ❌ Invalid format ✅ Do: • Enter @username (e.g. @mychannel) • Enter public link (e.g. https://t.me/mychannel) • Enter chat ID (e.g. -1001234567890) ❌ Don't: • Enter private invite links (t.me/+...) • Enter without @ symbol for usernames
buy_target.invalid_bot_token: ❌ Invalid bot token ✅ Do: • Copy token from @BotFather • Include full token (e.g. 123456789:ABC...) ❌ Don't: • Enter bot username • Enter partial token
buy_target.bot_not_found: ❌ Bot not found The token doesn't match any bot. ✅ Check: • Token is copied correctly from @BotFather • Bot hasn't been deleted • No extra spaces in the token
buy_target.channel_not_found: ❌ Channel not found We couldn't find this channel. ✅ Check: • Username is spelled correctly • Channel exists and is not deleted • For private channels, use the channel ID (e.g. -1001234567890)
buy_target.group_not_found: ❌ Group not found We couldn't find this group. ✅ Check: • Username is spelled correctly • Group exists and is not deleted • For private groups, use the group ID (e.g. -1001234567890)
buy_target.channel_type_mismatch: ❌ Wrong type You selected Channel, but this is a {actualType}. ✅ To fix: • Go back and select the correct type • Or enter a channel @username or ID
buy_target.group_type_mismatch: ❌ Wrong type You selected Group, but this is a {actualType}. ✅ To fix: • Go back and select the correct type • Or enter a group @username or ID
buy_target.channel_not_accessible: ❌ Cannot access channel Our bot doesn't have access to this channel. ✅ To fix: 1. Add our bot (@{botUsername}) to your channel as admin 2. Try again after adding 💡 For private channels: Use the channel ID instead (forward a message to @userinfobot to get it)
buy_target.group_not_accessible: ❌ Cannot access group Our bot doesn't have access to this group. ✅ To fix: 1. Add our bot (@{botUsername}) to your group 2. Try again after adding 💡 For private groups: Use the group ID instead (add @userinfobot to your group to get it)
buy_target.channel_no_permission: ❌ Missing permissions Our bot is in the channel but doesn't have permission to invite users. ✅ To fix: 1. Go to channel settings → Administrators 2. Find @{botUsername} 3. Enable "Add Members" permission 4. Try again
buy_target.group_no_permission: ❌ Missing permissions Our bot is in the group but doesn't have permission to invite users. ✅ To fix: 1. Go to group settings → Administrators 2. Find @{botUsername} 3. Enable "Add Members" permission 4. Try again
